The **Drill Fist** is a ★★★★ melee weapon in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Gleaming Depths* update. 

A unique, non-tradable version of the Gauntlet. It comes with a Fire DoT enchantment, with the Blade Bits (default weapon upgrade) providing a Bleeding DoT. Upgrading it with Ultracite Bits provides an additional Poison DoT effect.

The weapon also comes with four Legendary Weapon Mods preinstalled:
